sloka: उवाच वचनं धीमान् परितोषात्सगद्गदम् ।सुनाभं पर्वतश्रेष्ठं स्वयमेव शचीपतिः ॥५-१-१३९॥
transliteration: uvāca vacanaṁ dhīmān paritoṣātsagadgadam ।sunābhaṁ parvataśreṣṭhaṁ svayameva śacīpatiḥ ॥5-1-139॥

translations.english: Indra, the lord of Sachi, was personally satisfied and spoke to Mainaka, the best of mountains, in faltering tone, his throat choked out of joy.
